name: How long does the remote home buying process typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the remote home buying process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remote home buying process can vary, typically taking 30 to 60 days from accepted offer to closing, similar to a traditional purchase. Factors like loan approval times, inspection periods, and title searches influence the timeline. Utilizing digital signing and streamlined communication tools can help keep the process efficient, and our agents work to manage these timelines effectively across all our service areas, from Fort Lauderdale to Delray Beach.
